meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通读代码库中每一个源文件的完整内容(大文件会分块翻页),从而建立对项目的深入理解。
howto.when: 当你说“学习代码库”“读代码库”“get up to speed”等,或开始新/不熟悉的项目时触发。

say.text: 请通读整个代码库,我要基于它做新功能。
say.note: Claude 会从头到尾读取每个源文件。

say.text: 把这个项目完整读一遍,然后总结一下架构。
say.note: 它会深入阅读后给出架构总结。

say.text: 我刚开始接手这个仓库,请先熟悉全部源码。
say.note: Claude 会系统性地读全部源码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads every source file in the codebase in full, paging through large files, to build a deep understanding of the project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", etc.

say_en.text: Please read the entire codebase; I want to build a feature on it.
say_en.note: Claude reads every source file from start to finish.

say_en.text: Read the whole project and then summarize its architecture.
say_en.note: It reads deeply and then gives an architecture summary.

say_en.text: I just started on this repo; please get familiar with all the source.
say_en.note: Claude systematically reads all source files.
